title: On Driving the cattle down the lane
subtitle: 交通出行 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 交通出行（人与自我·生活与学习·出行与交通）
meta: 主题语境：交通出行（人与自我·生活与学习·出行与交通）　|　核心词汇：drive　|　正文 351 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 drive 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1972 the cook ① drove the cattle down the lane year after year, and every guest in the canteen said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three days on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the cook ② drives the cattle down the lane for the whole place without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ drive the cattle down the lane at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ driven the cattle down the lane before — a line in the menu for September 1966 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Driving the cattle down the lane year after year, the cook said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the bowl at the far table, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ drive the cart to market himself for the whole place, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Drive the cart to market himself at once and never mention it again.

By 1979 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the menu, and a new guest from the next canteen ⑧ drives the cart to market himself year after year every day without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the table, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ drove the cattle down the lane again when nobody else would.

⑩ To drive the cattle down the lane, my mother said in 1984, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the canteen remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the canteen forgets, somebody drives the cattle down the lane for the whole place again and somebody must drive the cattle down the lane year after year all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 驱赶（一般过去式 drove the cattle down the lane：1972 年厨子头一回这样做，年年地）
B. v. 驱赶（一般现在 drives the cattle down the lane：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 驱赶（不定式 to drive the cattle down the lane：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 驱赶（过去完成时 had driven the cattle down the lane：1966 年九月的菜单上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 驱赶（动名词 driving the cattle down the lane 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 驾驶（drive the cart to market himself：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去驾驶自己赶车去赶集）
G. v. 驾驶（drive the cart to market himself：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 驱赶（后段两处：新来的客人照例 drives the cart to market himself，而母亲又一次 drove the cattle down the lane）

drive 意为“驱赶”，结尾那句是母亲 1984 年的话：要驱赶把牛赶下那条小路，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和食堂记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 drive 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1972 the cook drove the cattle down the lane year after year, and nobody in the canteen forgot it.
Even now the cook drives the cattle down the lane for the whole place whenever the canteen asks.
Driving the cattle down the lane year after year, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever drive the cart to market himself for the whole place, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new guest from the next canteen drives the cart to market himself year after year every day, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother drove the cattle down the lane again, and the canteen remembered that half.
